kjv: without him (the Word) was not any thing made that was made. In him was life
mine: without Him (the Word) not one thing came into being. What has come into being in him was life
note: SBLGNT punctuates "ho gegonen" with v.4, following the earliest manuscripts and most early Fathers; the KJV attaches it to v.3. Both are grammatical.

kjv: the darkness comprehended it (the light) not
mine: the darkness has not overcome it (the light)
note: katalambano = seize, overtake (cf. 12:35); "comprehended" (in 1611 also "grasped") now reads as "understood".

kjv: the only begotten of the Father
mine: the only Son from the Father
note: monogenes = one of a kind, unique (Heb 11:17 of Isaac); "only begotten" follows the Latin "unigenitus". Also at 1:18, 3:16, 3:18.

kjv: the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom
mine: the only God, Who is at the Father's side
note: P66, P75, Sinaiticus, Vaticanus read "monogenes theos"; the TR "monogenes huios" is the easier, later reading. The early text calls the Son "God" a second time in the prologue.
Bethabara is Origen's conjecture, adopted in later manuscripts; the early text reads "Bethany".
TR "Iona" assimilates to Mt 16:17; P66, P75, Sinaiticus, B read "Ioannou".

kjv: Hereafter ye shall see heaven open
note: TR adds "ap' arti" (from now on) from Mt 26:64.
